remarks: Welcome home to your 2 bed, 2.5 bath townhouse in the sought-after Greenbriar community! This light-filled, move-in-ready home offers an open floor plan with hardwood floors, a cozy wood-burning fireplace, and access to a sunroom/office overlooking the peaceful courtyard-ideal for working from home. The spacious living and dining areas flow into an eat-in kitchen featuring granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, ample storage, a breakfast bar, and sliders to a private deck. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bath and an abundance of closet space. The primary suite boasts a newly renovated, luxurious bathroom, while the second bedroom offers a large walk-in closet. New Renewal by Anderson window and Ecobee thermostats make for an energy efficient home. Enjoy the convenience of one covered parking space, an additional assigned spot, and plenty of guest parking. Located in a well-managed, quiet complex just steps from shopping, dining, parks, public transportation, and all that vibrant Downtown Stamford has to offer. The perfect balance of comfort, style, and unbeatable location!
